arc.energy_shape_notes: No single climax: one long first arc (0:07-4:20), a 29s abyss containing the loudest window of the track (-3.8dB at 4:40, a sub-bass slam, not a drop), a long wandering middle, two short dark interludes, and a final stretch that ends loud AND dark (-6.3dB mean in the last 10s, centroid 485Hz) with a hard stop at 850.5s on F#, a semitone off home. 14 windows at or below -20dB are scattered across the whole runtime, so the floor can disappear anywhere. Track gets louder as it goes and ends at its loudest - the opposite of a fade-out arc.

harmony.home_scale: F minor (F G Ab Bb C Db Eb) for the first 2:00, confidence 0.55-0.73; then unstable. F flips to F major at 2:00 (parallel-mode toggle on the same root). D major 4:00-5:00. Clean E minor <-> G major relative major/minor oscillation 6:00-8:30, one side per ~30s, confidence up to 0.825. F minor returns 8:30-10:00 (weaker). Last 4 minutes low-confidence wandering (0.27-0.64) ending on F# - a semitone above home, displaced not resolved.
signature_devices: Relative major/minor oscillation: two-chord vamp between relative major and minor (here E min <-> G maj), one side per ~30s, sustained 2.5 min. Tension via mode ambiguity over a shared key signature; do not fix it into one key.
Parallel-mode toggle: F min flips to F maj at 2:00 on the same root - same device family as the third-toggle vamp, here a single flip.
Pedal tones in sparse windows: single pitch class dominates (D 0.84 at 4:10, F 0.86 at 10:30, C# 0.88 at 10:40, F# 1.0 in the final window).
No V-i cadences, no leading-tone motion, no stable modulation visible in the 30s key reads. Apparent modulation is mode-flipping on a static or relative root.
Four-on-the-floor implied at 136 BPM global; beat_times_s are downbeats (475 bar starts, 15.91-843.33s, spacing ~1.64-1.77s; 475x4=1900=n_beats).

Tempo arch: 143.6 (0:00-2:00) -> 136 -> 129.2 (3:00-5:00) -> 136 -> 143.6 (9:00-end). Sag coincides with pullback/abyss; recovery coincides with second stretch. Per-minute values are quantized estimates - trust the shape, not the exact BPM.
Abyss-then-sub-slam: floor drops to -22/-26dB for ~10s, then the loudest hit in the track as near-pure sub-bass (centroid <600Hz, rolloff <1100Hz, ZCR <0.03). 22.1dB swing in 15s at 4:25-4:40.
Scattered floor drops: 14 windows at or below -20dB spread across the whole runtime, not placed after peaks. No section ever feels safe.
Sub-surface punctuation at structural boundaries: top end leaves entirely for 1-2 windows (4:40, 8:30, 10:35-10:40, 14:05).
No smooth build anywhere: per-minute means wobble instead of ramping. The track climbs in steps and keeps getting interrupted.

tempo.feel: Four-on-the-floor at 136 BPM global with a real tempo arch: 143.6 for the first two minutes, sagging to 129.2 across 3:00-5:00, back to 136, then 143.6 from 9:00 to the end. No backbeat or polyrhythm claims are supported by the data. Beat tracker finds no downbeat until 15.91s - the opening has no detectable pulse.
